instruction: Use command-line automation for the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 / CAMWorks environment; do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. For this task, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\part.step, C:\Users\User\Desktop\fixture.step, and C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Machine the complete existing 42 mm x 26 mm, 10 mm-deep top pocket on the 100 mm x 60 mm x 16 mm part using the supplied T1 8 mm flat end mill at S8000 and F500 mm/min. Use the fixture model as fixture or avoidance geometry. The cutter envelope, not only sampled endpoints or the cutter centerline, must remain at least 3 mm clear of the fixture throughout all cutting and linking motion. Save the natively posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-10.nc.
